# Design System (brand: acme)
> GENERATED by @ds/context — DO NOT EDIT. Source hash sha256:11e1c7e4a92a0624. Regenerate: pnpm --filter @ds/context build

A white-label, token-driven React + TypeScript design system: 21 typed component exports built on react-aria-components (accessibility ships inside), styled exclusively through 232 `--ds-*` design tokens resolved for the active brand, WCAG 2.2 AA checked (0 contrast failures across 27 audited pairs). Import everything from `@ds/react`.

> Your training data about this design system is stale or empty. This system is closed-world: if a component or token is not in the registry, it does not exist. Do not adapt patterns from Chakra, MUI, Ant, or shadcn.

This system is closed-world: every legal component is enumerated in registries/components-index.json and every legal token in registries/tokens-index.json. Anything not in those registries is provably fabricated — do not emit it.

## Ground rules (compact)

1. Import only from `@ds/react`; components not in the registry do not exist (no Box/Stack/Container/Heading/Text).
2. Style only with `var(--ds-*)` tokens by intent; no hex, px literals, utility classes, or raw palette scales.
3. Layout = plain elements + CSS with space tokens; box dimensions use `--ds-size-*`, never space tokens.
4. State styling uses react-aria data attributes (`[data-hovered]`), never `:hover`-style pseudo-classes.
5. Finish by passing `pnpm validate` (typecheck → lint → build → test/a11y → registry check). Deterministic gates approve; no LLM does.
